about.p1: At BHB Travel and Tour we are passionate about showing the best of the Dominican Republic. Each excursion is designed for you to live unforgettable moments, with total safety and comfort.
about.p2: From Saona Island to ATV adventures, we take care of everything: transportation, food, drinks and the best entertainment.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.title:
What Our
Travelers Say
testimonial.s1.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonial.s1.text: The Saona Island tour was absolutely breathtaking! Crystal clear waters, amazing crew, and the buffet lunch was delicious. Highly recommend!
testimonial.s2.name: Manoj Tomar
testimonial.s2.text: Unforgettable ATV adventure! The cenote was stunning and the cultural stop with mamajuana tasting made it truly unique. A must-do!
testimonial.s3.name: Carolina Ruiz
testimonial.s3.text: The Party Boat exceeded all my expectations. The DJ, open bar, and snorkeling made this day absolutely magical. I will be back!
testimonial.s4.name: James Walker
testimonial.s4.text: Professional from start to finish. They picked us up right on time, the guides were knowledgeable, and Saona Island is paradise on earth.
testimonial.s5.name: Léa Dubois
testimonial.s5.text: The ATV tour was the highlight of our trip! Driving through the Dominican countryside and ending at Macao Beach was absolutely perfect.
testimonial.s6.name: Michael & Priya
testimonial.s6.text: Booked three tours with BHB and each one was better than the last. Exceptional service, great food, and memories we will cherish forever.

tour.buceocatalina.name: Scuba Diving in Catalina Island (2 Tanks)
tour.buceocatalina.note: Main requirements: diving license or certification and knowledge
tour.buceocatalina.f1: Hotel Pickup: Transfer in air-conditioned transport to La Romana marina.
tour.buceocatalina.f2: Boarding & Welcome: Diver registration, equipment assignment, and boat departure with refreshing drinks on board.
tour.buceocatalina.f3: Dive 1: "The Wall": Dive on a spectacular vertical wall that descends to 30 meters. Ideal for observing black corals, giant sponges, and pelagic fauna. (Companions snorkel at the top of the reef).
tour.buceocatalina.f4: Dive 2: "The Aquarium": Relaxed second dive at shallow depth (8-12 meters). A festival of color with schools of tropical fish, rays, and lobsters on a white sand bottom.
tour.buceocatalina.f5: Lunch & Beach: Disembark at Catalina Island's private beach. Free time to enjoy paradise, Dominican-style buffet lunch, and drinks.
tour.buceocatalina.shortDesc: Discover the underwater secrets of Catalina Island with two unforgettable dives.
tour.buceocatalina.importantInfo: Bring sunscreen, comfortable clothes, swimsuit, and towel. Diving license or certification is required.
